name: Dionysus GG Supreme Super Mini Bag
description:
Style: 476432 KHNRN 8642
GG Supreme canvas, with taupe suede detail
Tiger head
Palladium-toned hardware
Attached key ring that can attach to a separate bag
Tiger head closure
Chain shoulder strap with 23.6″ drop
Pin closure with side release
This item can fit a cell phone up to W69mm x H142mm x D7mm
The Gucci card case wallet will fit inside this product
Mini size: W16,5cm x H10cm x D4cm
Weight: .3kg approximately
